documents.title: Disclosures under Reg. 10(6) of SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Notice of Postal Ballot

analysis.summary: Kovai Medical Center and Hospital Limited reported a strong financial and operational performance for the fiscal year 2025-26, posting an operating income of Rs. 1,58,563.68 Lakhs and a Profit After Tax of Rs. 24,446.00 Lakhs. Management highlighted robust EBITDA margins of 29% and continued advancements in healthcare infrastructure, technology, and medical education, including the inauguration of a new Institute of Neuro Sciences & OPD Block and the board's approval to construct a 300-bed paediatric hospital. The hospital also achieved significant clinical milestones in robotic surgeries, ECMO runs, and adaptive radiation therapy.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that global healthcare demand is continuing to rise due to aging populations, rapid advancements in medical technology, and increasing patient expectations.
demand_outlook.quote: As global healthcare demand continues to rise—driven by aging populations, rapid advancements in medical technology, and increasing patient expectations—healthcare providers are under mounting pressure to develop cutting-edge hospitals, clinics, and medical campuses within tighter budgets and accelerated timelines.

demand_outlook.claim: The medical college has experienced significant growth with a substantial increase in patient intake and high demand for admission.
demand_outlook.quote: The Medical College has experienced significant growth over the past years, with a substantial increase in patient intake. Their reputation has become so esteemed that there is now high demand for admission to this prestigious medical school, with all seats being filled.

capex_expansion.claim: The board has approved the construction of a 300-bed paediatric hospital at the main center premises.
capex_expansion.quote: The board has approved for constructing 300 bed Paediatric Hospital at the main center premises and the work may commence during the second quarter 2026.

capex_expansion.claim: The Institute of Neuro Sciences & OPD Block represents a capital investment of ₹120 Crore.
capex_expansion.quote: Representing a capital investment of ₹120 Crore, this state-of-the-art facility operates as a vertical hub of medical excellence.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to add another 100 beds in the main campus.
capex_expansion.quote: We will add another 100 beds in the main campus.

capex_expansion.claim: Management is planning a 300-400 bed hospital in Chennai.
capex_expansion.quote: In addition we are planning a 300-400 bed hospital in Chennai.

capex_expansion.claim: The OP block in Chennai will be ready for operation by the end of the year.
capex_expansion.quote: The OP block will be ready for operation by this year end.

capex_expansion.claim: The company made a significant investment of ₹ 496.00 Lakhs in advanced medical equipment during the year 2024-25.
capex_expansion.quote: As part of its ongoing commitment to adopt cutting-edge medical technologies, your company made a significant investment of ₹ 496.00 Lakhs in advanced medical equipment during the year 2024–25.

capex_expansion.claim: Total investment in equipment during the year 2024-25 amounted to ₹ 3,358.36 Lakhs.
capex_expansion.quote: Investment in equipment during the year 2024-25 amounts to ₹ 3,358.36 Lakhs.

capex_expansion.claim: The company invested 5,239.02 Lakhs in equipment during the financial year 2023-24.
capex_expansion.quote: Investment in equipment during the year 2023-24 amounts to ` 5239.02 Lakhs.

capex_expansion.claim: The newly inaugurated super-speciality facilities at the Sulur branch now include added cath lab and MRI facilities.
capex_expansion.quote: The newly inaugurated super-speciality facilities at the Sulur branch of Kovai Medical Center now have added cath lab and MRI facilities.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated plans to build an upcoming neurosciences center equipped with state-of-the-art facilities.
capex_expansion.quote: The upcoming neurosciences center will be the first of its kind in this region, equipped with state-of-the-art facilities.

capex_expansion.claim: Management highlighted a focus on expanding the Department of Oncology.
capex_expansion.quote: We are also focused on expanding the Department of Oncology and addressing any existing gaps in medical care within this region.

margins_costs.claim: The hospital posted a robust EBITDA margin of 29% and a sustained PAT margin of 15% for the year 2025-26.
margins_costs.quote: Your hospital has posted a robust EBITDA margin of 29%, which is excellent compared to the current industry standards, and has shown a sustained PAT (Profit After Tax) margin of 15%.

margins_costs.claim: The profit margin for the year was 15%.
The company achieved a 31% savings on its annual power bill by utilizing solar and wind-generated power.
margins_costs.quote: This practice has enabled your company to save approximately 31% on the annual power bill.

margins_costs.claim: Biogas produced from decomposed biodegradable food waste resulted in reduced LPG costs in the hospital canteen.
margins_costs.quote: This initiative not only effectively manages waste but also results in reduced LPG costs, contributing to both environmental sustainability and cost savings.

orders_capacity.claim: The hospital is a 2000 bed hospital.
orders_capacity.quote: Our Hospital is a 2000 bed hospital.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors recommended a dividend of ₹15/- per share for the financial year 2025-26.
capital_allocation.quote: Based on Company’s performance, the Board of Directors are pleased to recommend a dividend of ₹15/- per share (150%) for the Financial Year 2025-26 subject to the approval of the members.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board has recommended a 100% dividend.
The dividend on equity shares, if approved, would involve a cash outflow of ₹ 1,094.23 lakhs.
capital_allocation.quote: The dividend on equity shares, if approved by the members would involve a cash outflow of ₹ 1,094.23 lakhs.

capital_allocation.claim: The company committed 271.25 Lakhs towards implementing CSR activities.
capital_allocation.quote: During the year under review in pursuance of the recommendations of the CSR Committee, the Company had commitment of ` 271.25 Lakhs being 2% of the last three years’ average net profit of the Company towards implementing the CSR activities.

risks_headwinds.claim: Constructing healthcare infrastructure presents unique challenges including stringent regulatory compliance, seamless technology integration, and round-the-clock operations.
risks_headwinds.quote: Constructing healthcare infrastructure presents unique challenges, including stringent regulatory compliance, seamless integration of advanced technologies, and the need for uninterrupted, round-the-clock operations.

management_commitments.claim: The construction work for the 300-bed paediatric hospital may commence during the second quarter of 2026.
management_commitments.quote: The board has approved for constructing 300 bed Paediatric Hospital at the main center premises and the work may commence during the second quarter 2026.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the OP block will be ready for operation by the end of this year.
management_commitments.quote: The OP block will be ready for operation by this year end.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to add another 100 beds in the main campus.
management_commitments.quote: We will add another 100 beds in the main campus.

management_commitments.claim: Management is planning a 300-400 bed hospital in Chennai.
management_commitments.quote: In addition we are planning a 300-400 bed hospital in Chennai.

management_commitments.claim: Dr. Nalla G Palaniswami was re-appointed as Managing Director of the Company for a period of five years effective from October 1, 2024.
management_commitments.quote: The Board in its meeting held on 25th May, 2024 had resolved to re-appoint Dr.Nalla G Palaniswami for a period of five years with effect from 01st October, 2024.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
